items.summary: SQL injection in FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the OFTP port execute code or commands via crafted OFTP packets. Affects FortiAnalyzer 7.2-8.0.1 and FortiManager 7.2-8.0.0; Fortinet published the fix on November 10.

Improper input validation in Zoom Workplace for Windows allows an unauthenticated user to escalate privileges via network access. Affects Zoom Workplace 7.1 before 7.1.8; Zoom rates it CVSS 9.6 and fixed it in its November security bulletin ZSB-26023.

A use-after-free in the replication component of MongoDB Server can be triggered by unauthenticated requests when a newly elected primary completes catch-up, crashing the server or, under certain conditions, leading to arbitrary code execution. Affects MongoDB Server 6.0 through 9.0.

A pre-authentication authorization bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway (before 9.4.0.030) lets an unauthenticated remote attacker invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted backup, taking over the appliance's global configuration. Barracuda confirms exploitation in the wild; CISA KEV remediation is due today, November 13.

An authentication bypass in the OSPF daemon of FortiOS and FortiSASE lets an unauthenticated attacker on an adjacent network broadcast crafted link-state advertisements. Affects FortiOS 7.0.1-8.0.1; Fortinet published the fix on November 10.
